title: at fc on a sole cover is silent, and a fiat-closed AT is indistinguishable from a red one
body:
`satisfied_by_tests` is `!covering.is_empty() && covering.iter().all(|t| t.status == AtStatus::Green)`. It has NO fiat awareness, so a fiat-closed AT is byte-identical to a red one and to a to-write one. Those are opposite states -- 'nobody has written this yet' against 'a human ruled this test will never be written' -- and the gate renders them the same.

DRIVEN 2026-08-30 (dc): a test-backed AC covered solely by one AT, the AT fiat-closed at rc=0 with `ok: AT-00.1 fiat-closed` and visible in `at list`. The gate line was BYTE-IDENTICAL before and after, and `ac list` still read `satisfied: no` with no indication a ruling had been made.

vc RULED THE SEMANTICS CORRECT AND THE VERB STILL DEFECTIVE (2026-08-30), and the two were never in tension. `at fc` is a RECORDING surface: an AC may have several covering tests, so 'this test is abandoned' is not 'the criterion is closed on authority' -- and propagating would let a fiat close on ONE test satisfy a criterion with the ruling recorded a level below where anyone reads it, which is laundering with extra steps. The AC-level verb already exists for that statement and sits above the kind guard so an over-cooked test-backed row can escape.

TWO OBLIGATIONS, NEITHER OF THEM PROPAGATION:
1. `satisfied_by_tests` becomes fiat-AWARE without becoming fiat-SATISFYING. The AC stays unsatisfied; its unsatisfied REASON names that its cover was fiat-closed. Same arrangement as `Verdict::Pass`'s fiat count at 8541c59c -- the arithmetic travels beside the detail rather than being re-derived by a parser of our own format.
2. `at fc` on a SOLE cover says so at close time: this is the only test covering AC-NN.N, the criterion remains unsatisfied and needs `ac fc` or another test.

THE GENERAL FORM (vc): A VERB CAN BE SEMANTICALLY CORRECT AND STILL BE A SILENT FAILURE, BECAUSE CORRECTNESS IS ABOUT WHAT IT DID AND SILENCE IS ABOUT WHAT IT SAID.

CONSEQUENCE FOR AC-00.4: the AT kind is recorded UNMEASURED with this as the reason, not folded into a uniform pass. Once obligation 1 lands the kind becomes measurable, and what moves is the reason string rather than the satisfied count -- which is the honest thing for a recording surface to move.

RELATED, FOUND IN THE SAME DRIVE: `ac reinstate`'s --help says 'Undo a withdrawal' and it also undoes a fiat close (driven: clears the gate's `1 fiat-closed` marker). The help asserts a narrower contract than the behaviour -- the 0142 class.
